description: This file defines the type for component props and includes a utility function to retrieve a display name for a model, prioritizing 'team_public_model_name' if available, otherwise falling back to 'model_name' or a default hyphen.

methods.name: getDisplayModelName
methods.description: Returns the display name for a model, preferring 'team_public_model_name' if present, otherwise returning 'model_name' or '-' if neither exists.
